chai: Masala chai, the desi way. Pour it high, from a brass kettle, straight into a clay kulhad. A pinch of elaichi, a curl of steam, and that's your evening sorted.
rocket: Three, two, one. The engines roar, the smoke billows out, and up she goes, past the hills, past the clouds, all the way to the stars.
sprout: Every big tree starts tiny. Drop a seed into the soil, give it a little water, let the sun do its magic, and watch it grow.
vibes: Positive vibes only. Close your eyes, and breathe in. Ignore the phone. It's just your landlord. Ignore the cloud. It's just your career. And the sunflower? Already dead. Namaste.
